_comment: One `exec` tool result, recorded verbatim from a TrueForge 0.1.4 session with the Daytona sandbox provider on 26 Aug 2026. The command built a project with the class-3 break (`regex=` removed in pydantic v2) and ran pytest against it. exitCode 2 is pytest's collection-error layout. Kept so the contract in bumpsmith.run is tested against what the harness actually sends rather than against a hand-written idea of it.
command:
cd /tmp && rm -rf demo && mkdir demo && cd demo && printf 'from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class User(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., regex="^[a-z]+$")
' > app.py && printf 'from app import User

def test_user():
    assert User(name="ada").name == "ada"
' > test_app.py && (python -m pip install -q pydantic pytest >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && python -m pytest -q
